content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Young Professional (II) Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional (II): Essential: Post graduate in Genetics/Plant Breeding/Seed Science and Technology. Desirable: Minimum two year experience in effective management, implementation and enhancement of quality seed production activities under the scheme.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age relaxation is applicable as per rules for SC/ST/PH & OBC Candidates.

content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Young Professional (II) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Young Professional (II) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Young Professional (II) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional (II) posts at ICAR IARI is scheduled for 23 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional (II) position?
faq.answer: The essential educational qualification is a Post Graduate degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, or Seed Science and Technology. Desirable experience in seed production is also mentioned.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional (II) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for this position is between 21 years (minimum) and 45 years (maximum). Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional (II) role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month for the Young Professional (II) position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Young Professional (II) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Young Professional (II) recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ICAR IARI office in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Young Professional (II) posts are on a contractual basis. The duration of the contract is not explicitly mentioned but is typical for such positions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SPU/VP/26-27/211.
